user.description: System user account under which nscd runs. Use a non-root user for security.

max_connection.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed. Increase under high load.

threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle requests. Match to CPU core count under high concurrency.

positive_time_to_live.description: TTL (seconds) for positive cache entries (successful lookups). Higher values reduce load but increase stale data risk.

negative_time_to_live.description: TTL (seconds) for negative cache entries (failed lookups). Keep low to avoid missing newly created accounts.

pwm_files.description: List of shared memory file paths for each cache type. Each entry maps to a cache type in order.

items.description: Absolute path to the shared memory file for a cache.

debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level (0 = silent, higher = more verbose). Set to 1+ only for troubleshooting.

reload_count.description: After how many cache reloads (due to file changes) the cache should be revalidated automatically.

max_db_id_len.description: Maximum length (bytes) of database identifier (e.g., filename) used for cache invalidation.
